summary: Frontend-only test at 390px (and 320px regression) of the three new Home-tab modules — HUMAN ATLAS, PINEAL VORTEX and TIME MATRIX. All assertions from the review request passed: (1) HUMAN ATLAS shows 206 BONES initially; atlas-layers-none → counter 0 LAYERS; atlas-layers-all → 206 BONES; mode chips AXIAL=80, APPENDICULAR=126, ALL=206; disabling SKELETON hides mode row and shows layer count (3); all system tabs SKELETON/CARDIOVASCULAR/NERVOUS/ORGANS render their expected parts (10/4/3/12); tapping atlas-part-heart shows 'HEART' / 'CARDIOVASCULAR' / correct description / 'RESONANCE CODES · CARDIO / BLOOD · 15' with 15 code rows; code row toggles ▶ → ■ → ▶; second tap deselects → 'SELECT A STRUCTURE'. (2) PINEAL VORTEX 9 phase rows show correct Hz (174/285/396/417/528/639/741/852/963) and single-digit codes 3,6,9,3,6,9,3,6,9; vortex-dur-30 gives idle status '30 S × 9 PHASES = 4:30'; vortex-start switches to '■ STOP PROTOCOL' with 'PHASE 1 — 174 Hz' / 'CODE 3' and decreasing '0:29 LEFT · FOUNDATION'; vortex-phase-5 jumps to 'PHASE 5 — 528 Hz'; vortex-baseline toggles SCHUMANN ON/OFF; vortex-start again restores label '▶ BEGIN VORTEX ACTIVATION STACK'. (3) TIME MATRIX canvas renders; matrix-d-1..15 exist; matrix-d-10 shows 'D10 · CHRISTIC MIND', '1173 Hz', 'DU-4 ARAMATENA — Hydroplasmic Pre-Matter · crystal liquid body', 'AVATARS · MAHARATA LIFE FORCE (D10–11)'; re-tap deselects to 'PARTICLE UNIVERSE …'; Hz formula 174+(d-1)*111 verified for D1=174, D5=618, D15=1728; matrix-ascend switches to '■ STOP ASCENSION' and advances D1→D2 within ~1.6s; matrix-reset appears while active and disappears after use. (4) Canvas taps: atlas iframe click at (cx-0.012u, top+0.30u) selects HEART; click at (cx, top+0.075u) selects SKULL with panel line '22 BONES · AXIAL'; matrix iframe click at ring idx=4 selects 'D5 · ARCHETYPE MIND'. (5) Regression: home-anatomy container present; CODES_LAB, EMF_HARMONIZER, CSF_FLOW, and '[ VIEW FULL ARCHIVE →]' text all still on Home; no horizontal overflow at 390 (scrollWidth=390) or 320 (scrollWidth=320); zero page errors and only pre-existing warnings (expo-av deprecation, shadow*, pointerEvents, onResponder*, TouchableMixin) observed — none new. Auto-advance from Phase 1 → Phase 2 after ~31 s was not directly waited-through in the script (time budget), but the visible countdown decreased correctly from 0:30 to 0:29 within 1.5 s of START, indicating the timer is running as designed.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-av package is deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Migrate audio playback/recording to expo-audio and video to expo-video. Reference: /app/frontend/package.json (expo-av) — surfaced by console warning '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated'.

action_items: (Pre-existing, low-priority) Replace expo-av with expo-audio (audio) and expo-video (video) before SDK 54 upgrade to avoid future removal breakage.

context_for_next_testing_agent: HUMAN ATLAS / PINEAL VORTEX / TIME MATRIX all pass on Home at 390 and 320 px with zero new console errors. Full auto-advance of the vortex protocol from Phase 1 → Phase 2 (~31 s wait with dur=30) was not exercised end-to-end due to time; countdown was observed decreasing correctly.
